title: Window Washing Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Window Washing: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Window Washing Estimate Worksheet covers window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish. The window service coordinator records Residential Window Washing observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Window Washing Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Window Washing exceptions visible until the window service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Window Washing Estimate Worksheet at residence interior, exterior elevation, ladder area, roof access, and protected room. Document window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish identity before Residential Window Washing begins. Compare window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish findings with stated Residential Window Washing criteria; route unresolved Residential Window Washing issues to exterior cleaning supervisor. For Window Washing Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Window Washing. Ask exterior cleaning supervisor to review Residential Window Washing conditions beyond the window service coordinator's role.

items: Unsafe height, weather, ground, roof, or electrical proximity

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Window Washing when safe access, damaged glazing, product compatibility, privacy, or opening security remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Window Washing proof and route unresolved window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish scope to window service coordinator.
